definitions.full: H7459. reabon רְעָבוֺן noun [masculine] hunger, lack of food, famine ; — construct בָּֽתֵּיכֶם רַעֲבוֺן Gen 42:19 , 33 (E); absolute רְעָבוֺן בִּימֵי Psa 37:19 .
